'''Managing Director''' was the title given to the head of a [[hyperbaride synthesis plant]]. [[Arviz Linden]] was the managing director of a [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]] until he was succeeded by [[Vost Tyne]].
